bio.text: Rob Bonta has been California's Attorney General since he was sworn in on April 23, 2021.
Born in Quezon City, Philippines, he immigrated to California with his family as an infant and holds a Juris Doctor from Yale Law School.
Before becoming Attorney General he served more than eight years in the California State Assembly and earlier worked as a San Francisco deputy city attorney and in private practice.
